---
title: "Public Policy"
description: "Indian state capacity, regulation, federalism, political economy, and policy frameworks"
toc: true
toc-depth: 2
---

Public policy is the throughline of all my work. I research India's state capacity puzzles, regulatory quality, competitive federalism, and the political economy of reform. My goal is to make policy frameworks accessible to students, practitioners, and curious readers.

::: {.topic-hero}
::: {.topic-hero-card}
### Book

[*Missing in Action: Why You Should Care About Public Policy*](../books.html) (Penguin India, 2023) is a primer on Indian public policy through stories, frameworks, and Bollywood references.
:::

::: {.topic-hero-card}
### Frameworks

A plain-language collection of [public policy frameworks](https://frameworks.pranaykotas.com) and mental models for thinking about policy problems.
:::

:::
